findings.title: A payment webhook with no signature header is accepted and credits the order
findings.impact: Anyone who knows or guesses an order id can post a payment event and receive the order's coins without paying.

proof.command: node scripts/probe.mjs send webhook.json --drop-header paylane-signature --observe me.json
proof.result: The request answered 200 and the balance rose from 0 to 500 with no signature present.

findings.fix: Reject the request when the header is missing: verify unconditionally before parsing the body.

findings.title: Promo credits change the balance and leave no record

location.snippet: db.prepare('UPDATE users SET balance = balance + ? WHERE id = ?').run(promo.coins, ctx.user.id);

findings.impact: A balance cannot be reconstructed from stored rows, so abuse of promo codes cannot be sized or undone afterwards.

steps.note: The balance is one mutable column and no ledger table exists in the schema.
The promo credit updates the column and inserts nothing.

findings.fix: Insert a ledger row for every balance change in the same transaction as the update.
